info.name: Voltix API
info.description:
Full Voltix API collection.

Setup: set the collection variables `baseUrl`, `adminEmail`, `adminPassword`. Then run folder "00 · Scenario" with the Collection Runner.
Folders 01–13 are a manual reference; they use ids stored by the scenario (productId, variantId, ...).
The Stripe webhook (/webhooks/stripe, no /api/v1 prefix) is not included: it needs a signed payload, use `stripe listen` / `stripe trigger`.

item.name: 00 · Scenario — admin → operator → stock
item.description: Automated end-to-end check of the staff flow. Run this folder in order with the Collection Runner. Creates a category, a brand, an operator, a product and a variant with a unique run id, then verifies who may do what.

item.name: 01 Admin login
item.description: Run the folder with the Collection Runner (in order). Needs adminEmail / adminPassword collection variables.

exec: pm.test('response has an access token', () => pm.expect(token, 'keys: ' + Object.keys(j)).to.be.a('string'));
const rt = j.refreshToken || j.refresh_token || (j.tokens && j.tokens.refreshToken); if (rt) pm.collectionVariables.set('adminRefresh', rt);

pm.collectionVariables.set('productData', JSON.stringify({ name: `QA Laptop ${pm.collectionVariables.get("runId")}`, description: "Created by the Postman scenario", brandId: pm.collectionVariables.get("brandId"), categoryId: pm.collectionVariables.get("categoryId"), specs: {}, isActive: true }));
pm.collectionVariables.set('variantData', JSON.stringify({ sku: `QA-${pm.collectionVariables.get("runIdUpper")}`, name: "Base model", priceMinor: 129900, reorderLevel: 3, isActive: true }));
pm.test('price kept in minor units', () => pm.expect(j.priceMinor).to.eql(129900));
pm.test('response has an access token', () => pm.expect(token, 'keys: ' + Object.keys(j)).to.be.a('string'));
const rt = j.refreshToken || j.refresh_token || (j.tokens && j.tokens.refreshToken); if (rt) pm.collectionVariables.set('operatorRefresh', rt);
pm.test('on hand is 10, not a replay', () => { pm.expect(j.stock.onHand).to.eql(10); pm.expect(j.replayed).to.eql(false); pm.expect(j.movement.type).to.eql('STOCK_IN'); });
pm.test('8 on hand and available', () => { pm.expect(j.stock.onHand).to.eql(8); pm.expect(j.stock.available).to.eql(8); });

item.name: 24 Public product page after the stock changes (cache probe)
item.description: Probe: stock movements do not touch the catalog cache. If available is not 7, the public page serves stale availability.

item.name: 25 Admin: movements ledger for the variant

exec: pm.test('ledger has STOCK_IN, STOCK_OUT and ADJUSTMENT', () => { pm.expect(types).to.include.members(['STOCK_IN', 'STOCK_OUT', 'ADJUSTMENT']); });
pm.test('replay did not create a second STOCK_IN', () => pm.expect(types.filter((t) => t === 'STOCK_IN').length).to.eql(1));
pm.test('every row has an actor', () => pm.expect(j.items.every((m) => m.actorId)).to.eql(true));
